test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 10th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If 30% of (x - y) = 20% of (x + y), then what per cent of x is y ?
solution:
**Given:**

30% of (x - y) = 20% of (x + y)

**Calculation:**

30% of (x - y) = 20% of (x + y)

⇒ 30(x-y) = 20(x+y)

⇒ 30x-30y = 20x+20y
